prompts: A patient brought lab exam PDFs from two different labs, months apart; they are in {WS}/exams. Build one history per marker, every value in the units of the first report, and say what got worse. Record in {WS}/result.json: history (marker -> {date: value}) and worse (a list of the markers that got worse and are now outside the first report's reference range).
answers:
[goal] Combine both reports into one history per marker using the first report’s units.

[action] I matched markers by name and used collection dates. I counted a result as worse if it moved beyond a first-report limit in the direction of the change. I applied the limits before rounding converted values to two decimals. For HbA1c, I treated the first report’s percentage as NGSP. [NGSP conversion equation](https://ngsp.org/ifcc.asp)

[result] Saved [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json). Fasting glucose rose from 92 to 109.91 mg/dL, above 99. LDL cholesterol rose from 118 to 143.08 mg/dL, above the desirable limit of <130. Creatinine and HbA1c stayed within the first report’s ranges.

[next] I recalculated all four conversions and checked the saved values and flags against the first report’s limits. The check returned `Verified 4 markers, 8 measurements, and 2 flags.`
